about: How twelve directors pursue a shot and build a sequence, one value per dimension of dimensions.json. These are their habits as film scholarship commonly describes them, written as starting rows for Erick to edit; none is a measurement. A take or a strategy may say "style": "<id>" and inherits the row's values as defaults. 'for_us' names the beats of the Stonehenge film where the row fits; 'avoid' where it fights the material.

kubrick.name: Stanley Kubrick
kubrick.signature: One-point perspective: the line of the space dead centre, the frame symmetric, a slow track or zoom along the axis.
for_us: the axis push-ins (A_axis_5s and its winter match)
the slot as a one-point corridor
the alignment held

tarkovsky.name: Andrei Tarkovsky
tarkovsky.signature: The long take in which time is the subject: the camera drifts in so slowly it is noticed only at the end; water, wind, grass and weather inside the frame.
for_us: the walk in along the Avenue
the held dawn after first light
the carr with wind in the leaves

malick.name: Terrence Malick
malick.signature: Magic hour only, a wide lens low to the ground, the camera moving through grass toward the light; the Sun left in the frame.
for_us: the Avenue at 3 degrees of Sun
the carr and the river
the grass near the camera
avoid: precise alignments (the lens is too wide to read a degree)

kurosawa.name: Akira Kurosawa
kurosawa.signature: Telephoto compression from far back, the camera locked while the world moves; weather is a character; the cut lands on action.
for_us: the Sun crossing the slot, camera locked (sun_track_tele without the track)
clouds and their shadows crossing the circle
wind over the Plain

ozu.name: Yasujirō Ozu
ozu.signature: A low fixed camera; nothing moves but time; 'pillow shots' of place between scenes; the event happens at the edge of the frame.
for_us: the inserts between acts (a lintel edge, the Heel Stone alone)
the empty monument held
the contrast insert as a pillow shot

fricke_reggio.name: Ron Fricke and Godfrey Reggio (Baraka, Koyaanisqatsi)
fricke_reggio.signature: Time-lapse from a locked camera, slow dollies through stillness, the scale ladder from the planet down to one stone; the music is the structure.
for_us: the spine of the film: it is already the grammar
the overhead sundial
the spiral down into dusk
avoid: voice over the picture (they have none; we have decided on one, so place it in the gaps)

lean.name: David Lean
lean.signature: Landscape as epic: the very wide frame with a low horizon, and the long approach in which a figure appears on the horizon and grows for a full minute.
for_us: the Heel Stone seen from far down the Avenue, growing
the circle appearing on the Plain in the walk in
the Sun arriving at the skyline

villeneuve.name: Denis Villeneuve
villeneuve.signature: Scale by a small thing against a vast one; the slow reveal; haze and dust between camera and subject; a muted palette and long, low drones.
for_us: the Plain from above with the circle small in it
aerial perspective doing the work (AERIAL=1 already)
the descent to eye height
avoid: the window shots (they need the Sun, not haze)

herzog.name: Werner Herzog
herzog.signature: The landscape held past comfort, and a voice that says what the image cannot; the camera does not help the viewer.
for_us: every voice line: where it goes and where it stops
the hold after the Sun has gone
the equinox shots that say 'the monument does not frame it'
avoid: the match cut (he does not play games with time)

leone.name: Sergio Leone
leone.signature: The extreme wide against the extreme close with nothing between; waiting as tension; the music is the clock.
for_us: from the overhead straight to the lintel's edge (the jump)
the seconds before the Sun touches the slot
the Sun's disc at 6 degrees, nothing else in frame

hitchcock.name: Alfred Hitchcock
hitchcock.signature: Show the looker, then what is seen; the eye-trace carries the cut; the next shot's point of interest sits where the eye already is.
for_us: the hand-off from the overhead to the on-axis shot (the Sun stays where the eye is)
the summer-winter match cut
'the builders looked here' then the shot of what they saw

antonioni.name: Michelangelo Antonioni
antonioni.signature: Figures inside architecture; the frame stays after the action has left it; the built thing outlasts the event.
for_us: the ends of shots: hold after the Sun is gone
the coda to black
the stones at noon with no event
